verdicts.originalText: The Hold shield guards only Beidou herself and lasts just for the brief moment she braces to parry, so it is not drawn as a lasting shield window.
verdicts.proposedText: The hold shield guards only the caster and lasts just the brief moment of the parry, so it is not drawn as a lasting shield window.
verdicts.rationale: Legitimate divergence: the shield's duration is intentionally omitted (a ~0.38s cast-time parry release, not a held window), so no lasting shield bar is drawn — a user could otherwise think the shield was missed. Not implementDelete: the engine can render shield windows, but a duration is deliberately not authored here (self-parry, mirrors Yun Jin). Only fix needed is de-naming the character per STYLE.names; text was already concise and one sentence.
